dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Do you have any special treasures?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Hello, Miss Jahoda, I haven't seen you in a while. Not since you—

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, we can skip the small talk, Tarno. The north{RUBY#[D]Snezhnaya spies}erly wind has been rather chi{RUBY#[D]rather active}lly over the last few days, and Boss Nef wants me to get some windproofing supplies here.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Haha, got it. We wouldn't want to get frostbite from the northerly wind, yes. The windproofing supplies will be with you shortly. I should also tell you that although it's just a faint rustle of wind at this point, the Voynich Guild is already concerned.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Sure, sure. You people can talk to Boss Nef about that later on. But now, we have to act fast. I'll head back to report to her first.
